# SCHLÜSSELMACHER24 Architecture Blueprint

This project implements a high-end Swiss Light Mode Design System using OKLCH color space with Next.js 16+, React 19.2+, and TypeScript 5.5+.

Key tenets:
- Zero-new-routes invariant
- Strict 8px spatial rhythm
- Swiss Light Glassmorphism and precise typography

For more details, see `.jules/architecture-matrix.md` and `.jules/revolution-plan.json`.
